---
title: "Exercise 7"
format: docx
---
In RStudio, do the following.

1.  Look over the project instructions file and different options for pain points to address, and write a plan for how you will accomplish your project. Include at least a few sentences addressing every part of the project, including cleaning the data, creating visualizations, creating the dashboard, and the executive summary.

2. Render your plan as a Word document, and upload to Canvas. **Five points total, one point each for**:

•	**Plans to clean the data**

•	**Plans for what kind of visualizations you may create**

•	**Plans for the dashboard**

•	**A possible outline of the executive summary**

•	**Submitting the rendered Word Doc**


The example dashboard and executive summary are good resources to judge if your plan is on the right track.
